title: 아직 여기 v2

source.STYLE: Bittersweet 8-bit/16-bit game-score electronica, 125 BPM, 4/4, Eb major, around six minutes. An original sad, singable chip hook in crisp square/pulse tones stays the MAIN VOICE throughout, even at the climax. First 16 bars (~30s): solo dry thin 8-bit synth, exposed repeating 2-4-note monophonic loop, one note at a time; no chords, pads, drums, bass or percussion. Enrich the SAME hook with 16-bit-like harmonies and counterparts. Add punchy big-beat drums, THEN bass, THEN fuller electronic layers UNDER and AROUND the persistent chip melody. Never replace its game-like voice with a supersaw, piano or modern EDM lead. Exhilarating rhythm, fragile sorrowful melody. Alternate accumulation with brief subtraction and strong re-entry; an uneasy low-bass middle leads to the final return of the same chip hook in thicker instrumental harmony. Clear chip lead, weighty drums, studio sound. No vocals.
source.EXCLUDE: crowd cheers/claps/chants/room bleed, vocals, bell or piano intro, pad or arpeggio intro, full-band intro, arcade sound effects, cheerful novelty game music, supersaw or modern EDM lead replacing chip melody
source.TITLE: 아직 여기 v2
